name: context-notes
description: Select text in a Codex Chat answer and ask about it right beside the selection.

interface.shortDescription: Ask about selected Chat text in place
interface.longDescription: Select part of an assistant answer in Codex Chat on Windows. A small entry appears beside the selection; clicking it opens a compact question box next to the quoted text. A background helper starts with your Codex sessions through a lifecycle hook. It reads only the current selection through Windows UI Automation and never injects into or modifies Codex.
